claims: All Target stores in the United States will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Target stores will reopen for regular business hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Customers can still shop on Target.com and the Target app.
Target stores open regular hours on Easter Saturday, April 4, 2026.
Target stores generally open at 8 a.m. on Easter Saturday, April 4, 2026.
Walmart remains open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Some pharmacies remain open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
